title: Кібератака групи UAC-0056 на державні органи України з використанням шкідливих програм GraphSteel та GrimPlant (CERT-UA#4293)

entities.name: UAC-0056
entities.gloss: A cyberespionage threat group targeting Ukrainian organizations and government bodies.

entities.name: державні органи України
entities.gloss: The state and governmental bodies and agencies of Ukraine.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign state in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: Заборгованість по зарплаті.xls
entities.gloss: A malicious Excel spreadsheet containing macros used to drop an initial executable payload.

entities.name: Base-Update.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable written in GoLang acting as a stage-one downloader.

entities.name: GoDownloader
entities.gloss: A malware downloader family written in GoLang designed to fetch and execute secondary payloads.

entities.name: GoLang
entities.gloss: An open-source compiled programming language developed by Google.

entities.name: GraphSteel
entities.gloss: An information stealing malware family written in GoLang.

entities.name: GrimPlant

entities.name: java-sdk.exe

entities.name: oracle-java.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable payload associated with the GrimPlant backdoor.

entities.gloss: A malicious executable payload associated with the GraphSteel infostealer.
